name: amazon-tag-preserve
citation: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/topic/t10 — tag is the canonical Associate ID parameter.

name: ebay-campid-preserve
citation: https://partnernetwork.ebay.com/ — campid is the EPN affiliate parameter.

name: vercel-ref-preserve
description: SaaS-tier direct-injection program (Vercel) preserves the `ref` parameter.
citation: https://vercel.com/docs/accounts/referrals — ref carries the referrer's identifier on the merchant's first-party URL.

name: amazon-tag-empty-defer
description: Empty value → not a creator referral per SPEC §2 → defer.
citation: SPEC §2 terminology: 'Creator referral ... whose value is not empty.'

name: amazon-no-tag-defer
description: Manifest host but no creator-referral parameter present → defer.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 4: parameters that are not creator referrals are left to the implementer's tracker-removal logic.

name: unrelated-host-defer
description: Host not in the manifest → defer regardless of param shape.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1: matching is `(host, paramName)` tuples — a tag parameter on a non-manifest host is not a creator referral.

name: creator-first-third-party-wins
description: Implementer's own tag and a third-party tag are both present → preserve third-party, strip own.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 2 — creator-first rule: third-party referral takes precedence over the implementer's own tag.

name: creator-first-only-owner-preserves-owner
description: Only the implementer's own tag is present → preserve it (no conflict to resolve).
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 2 — when no third-party referral is present, the implementer's own tag is preserved.

name: multiple-third-party-prefer-first
description: Multiple third-party tags (no owner conflict) → preserve the one that appears first by URL position.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 2 last bullet — preserve the parameter that appears first in the URL's query string.

name: www-amazon-canonical
description: A leading www. is stripped before host matching → preserve the tag.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — canonicalisation lowercases and strips a leading 'www.'.

name: booking-aid-deprecated-defer
description: Booking.com's `aid` direct-injection entry was soft-deprecated 2026-05-05 after Booking terminated direct affiliate partnerships (May 2025) and migrated to network channels (primarily Awin). Per SPEC §3.2 step 1, deprecated entries MUST NOT match — `?aid=` on booking.com is no longer a creator referral and falls through to defer.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 + §5.1.1 — deprecated entries are inert. Coverage continues under awin network-redirect for booking's new affiliate channel.

name: digitalocean-refcode-preserve
description: DigitalOcean referrals attribute via ?refcode= on digitalocean.com (first-party URL, no redirect).
citation: https://www.digitalocean.com/referral-program — refcode is the referral identifier on the merchant's first-party URL.

name: humble-bundle-partner-deprecated-defer
description: Humble Bundle's `partner` direct-injection entry was soft-deprecated 2026-05-05 after the program migrated to Impact (network-redirect via *.pxf.io). Per SPEC §3.2 step 1, deprecated entries MUST NOT match — `?partner=` on humblebundle.com is no longer a creator referral and falls through to defer.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 + §5.1.1 — deprecated entries are inert. Incident #35; coverage continues under impact-radius for *.pxf.io redirects.

name: lemon-squeezy-aff-preserve
description: Lemon Squeezy attributes via ?aff= on the seller's lemonsqueezy.com store URL (first-party URL, no redirect).
citation: https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/affiliates/affiliate-system — aff carries the affiliate's identifier on the seller's first-party URL.

name: apple-phg-at-preserve
description: Apple Performance Partners attributes via ?at= on the merchant's first-party Apple Services URL (no redirect — the affiliate token is appended directly to music.apple.com / tv.apple.com / books.apple.com / podcasts.apple.com / apps.apple.com / itunes.apple.com / geo.music.apple.com).
citation: https://performance-partners.apple.com/linking — at is the affiliate token appended directly to the Apple service URL with no redirect; ct is a separate optional campaign-name field that MUST NOT be matched as a creator referral.
